title: CISA Admin Leaked AWS GovCloud Keys on Github

title: Zero-Day Exploit Against Windows BitLocker
summary: It’s nasty, but it requires physical access to the computer: The exploit, named YellowKey, was published earlier this week by a researcher who goes by the alias Nightmare-Eclipse.
